This installed engine package is version 0.2.3. It retains its separate MPL-2.0 and bundled third-party terms.
Its sources/core-source.json pins LibreOffice core commit bce0998afefdbc355585ca324285661a2170ba77:
https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/tree/bce0998afefdbc355585ca324285661a2170ba77
The package includes the engine modifications, source identity, patches and build recipe under sources/.
These files are distributed unchanged within the App runtime at node_modules/@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit-win32-x64/sources/
They are also obtainable in this exact publisher archive:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit-win32-x64/-/libreoffice-kit-win32-x64-0.2.3.tgz
The integration repository is https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-libreoffice-kit .
The program and WebAssembly engine may carry different patches; use the source files from the corresponding package.
Original licence texts and notices from this installed package are reproduced in this evidence set.
The App MIT licence does not relicense any bundled third-party component.
